scope.summary: A StudioTextStory MAY be converted to editable vector geometry — a StudioVectorNetwork/StudioVectorPath of glyph outlines — for logo/path work; this is destructive to text editability and is the SAME vector primitive used by 14.5 (PS convert-to-shape/work-path; AI/ID create-outlines; Figma text-to-outlines, deduped). Filling glyph shapes with an image is expressed as a StudioMask/clipping relation, not a bespoke type feature (PS fill-text-with-image).
acceptance_criteria: convert-to-outline yields shared StudioVectorPath geometry; image-in-glyphs via StudioMask; no bespoke type feature
expected_tests: live: text converts to StudioVectorNetwork/StudioVectorPath glyph outlines (same 14.5 primitive, no fork)
test: fill-glyphs-with-image expressed as StudioMask/clipping relation

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No text-to-vector; logo/path type workflows unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
